en.headline: Shui Pin Wai Estate hit by second power cut within 18 hours
en.dek: CLP Power said temporary cables caused unstable supply affecting about 2,200 households for roughly 30 minutes on Tuesday night; fire services handled lift entrapment reports.
body: Residents of Shui Pin Wai Estate in Yuen Long experienced a second power interruption on Tuesday night, less than 18 hours after an earlier underground cable fault left about 2,400 households without electricity for several hours.

CLP Power said that at about 10.31pm, temporary cable lines installed after the morning outage suffered suspected supply instability, affecting around 2,200 customers in the estate. Engineers carried out immediate repairs and remote restoration, returning power to all affected customers within 30 minutes.

Fire services received reports of people trapped in lifts during the evening outage. District councillors attended the scene and community facilities remained available for residents seeking cooler conditions while temperatures in the area stayed above 30 degrees Celsius.

CLP said staff would remain on site overnight to handle any further issues. For the earlier fault that began around 4.22am on Tuesday, the company said preliminary investigations pointed to possible third-party interference with the underground cable and that inquiries were continuing.

zh.headline: 水邊圍邨18小時內兩度停電 臨時電纜供電不穩
zh.dek: 中電指周二晚臨時電纜線路懷疑供電不穩，影響約2,200戶約半小時；消防接獲困𨋢報告。
body: 元朗水邊圍邨居民周二晚再遇停電，距離凌晨因地底電纜故障導致約2,400戶停電數小時後不足18小時。
中電表示，晚上約10時31分，早前搶修後鋪設的臨時電纜線路懷疑因供電不穩，一度影響邨內約2,200名客戶。工程人員即時搶修及以遙距方式復電，約30分鐘內為所有受影響客戶恢復供電。
停電期間消防接獲困𨋢報告。區議員到場了解，社區設施繼續開放供居民避暑，當時元朗氣溫仍超過30度。
中電表示已派員通宵留守現場應對突發情况。至於周二凌晨約4時22分起的地底電纜故障，初步調查懷疑與第三方干擾有關，公司會繼續跟進。
